879af0bb-ce30-47e4-a74e-cd1ce874c6e3.description: Having died of sickness at the age of 39, Machio Hiraku is given the opportunity to go to another world. When asked what his wish is by God intending to give him strength, he requests to have a healthy body, offered a second wish, he chooses to live peacefully, a third wish to be able to know the local language, and for a final wish, to be able to be a farmer.

6ad54367-4165-43ed-9a7d-71179c520180.title: Yani Neko
6ad54367-4165-43ed-9a7d-71179c520180.description:
Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. 

Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit.  Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. 

Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. 

But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?
___

3da2a4a7-1c77-46f7-bbfc-cd7b09b11140.title: Liar, Where Are Vampires!
3da2a4a7-1c77-46f7-bbfc-cd7b09b11140.altTitle: ルームシェアしたら、全員吸血鬼だった
3da2a4a7-1c77-46f7-bbfc-cd7b09b11140.description:
Dongha, who has lived with his father all this time, followed the will of his father to go to the city. Luckily with 30, 000 won, he rented an amazing house and met friends from the same department. They are kind and angelic friends who generously gave the nude Dongha food and daily necessities but…   
  
Dongha's friends are real-life vampires, who droll secretly as Dongha get chubbier. All the while, they laughed in glee, saying "There are many nice people in the world."- seeing that they've caught an innocent and naive human. But they soon fell in love for Dongha's innocence…   
  
One day, when they showed off their pale shoulders in bed to Dongha (who lives by the motto of paying back with whatever he has), the vampires get into a situation and started to nosebleed…  
  
Will they be able to drink Dongha's blood safely while keeping their hearts in line?

73320da2-eac6-4ff5-a12d-30788624d85b.title: Overlord: <Shin> Sekai-hen
73320da2-eac6-4ff5-a12d-30788624d85b.description: After winning the battle of Katze Plains and founding the Sorcerer Kingdom of Ainz, they aim for a utopia of perpetual continuity and prosperity, a world where many races kneel before Ainz. As the first step toward achieving this goal, Ainz heads to the Empire to strengthen the Adventurer's Guild and incorporate it into the state. Behind the scenes, the nations of the world are beginning to stir with their own agendas for the Sorcerer Kingdom...! Ainz's high road, once again!

245f2aac-1aee-4983-b2d5-34ea5dab460e.title: xxxHOLiC Rei
245f2aac-1aee-4983-b2d5-34ea5dab460e.description: Sequel to *xxxHolic*. A new story begins with Watanuki and Yuuko, while guests' wishes are granted.

3aa6cd45-a36e-4abd-ab1c-f60f1db0014a.title: Natsume to Natsume
3aa6cd45-a36e-4abd-ab1c-f60f1db0014a.description: Natsume Shiranui has the face of a villain. From strangers on the street to his own high school classmates, his creepy grin freaks everybody out. But secretly he yearns to be a hero like his childhood friend — the kind, brave, and beautiful Natsume Minazuki. Can he become her hero, or is he destined to always be the one getting rescued? From the creator of The Girl with the Sanpaku Eyes, Natsume & Natsume is a wholesome romantic comedy about becoming a hero for the person you love.

7e376c3c-adca-47ab-8436-2dac862a5f9e.title: Mimosa
7e376c3c-adca-47ab-8436-2dac862a5f9e.description: The war surrounding the veil at the center of the world is over. However, the war was not the only thing the veil left in its wake. There are those who pursue the veil and those who seek to close it; those who wield special powers and those who are living weapons; those who disturb the peace and those who bring hope; those who collide with the paths they have walked and those who carry a coffin, seeking to resurrect the dead. Together, they are known as Actors.

9f4a3252-6dc3-48fb-b0c1-cf7f63e1219d.title: Godae Dongmulgi
9f4a3252-6dc3-48fb-b0c1-cf7f63e1219d.description: What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for? A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives. A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

8c1d7d0c-e0b7-4170-941d-29f652c3c19d.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Maomao no Koukyuu Nazotoki Techou
8c1d7d0c-e0b7-4170-941d-29f652c3c19d.altTitle: The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao's Notes from the Inner Palace
8c1d7d0c-e0b7-4170-941d-29f652c3c19d.description: In the imperial court, a young woman is put into servitude, Maomao. The tale is just beginning for the female apothecary from the red-light district, as rumors circulate about the emperor's children's lives being short-lived. Her curious nature and thirst for knowledge pushes her to action. To satisfy her curiosity, this young apothecary will investigate the origin! What is shifting in the imperial court...!?

491aba94-e971-4911-8a93-0b1200403f4b.title: Major
491aba94-e971-4911-8a93-0b1200403f4b.description:
Shigeharu Honda is a Japanese League batter on the rise. His son Goro is a Little League pitcher who one day hopes to follow in his father's footsteps. Momoko Hoshino, Goro's schoolteacher, is the first woman Shigeharu has been interested in since the death of Goro's mother. The destinies of these three individuals will become intertwined as father and son experience both heartbreak and triumph on the baseball diamond. But when an unspeakable tragedy visits the family, it will take everything they have to pick up the pieces and reclaim their dreams.  
  
Won the 41st Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen category.

6a26e474-0f5a-4677-b172-520cac5fa190.title: Jibun wo SSS-kyuu da to Omoikonde Iru C-kyuu Majutsu Gakusei
6a26e474-0f5a-4677-b172-520cac5fa190.altTitle: C-level Magic Student Who Thinks He is SSS Class
6a26e474-0f5a-4677-b172-520cac5fa190.description: The strongest man in school usually hides his true strength and acts like an ordinary student... There was a man who staked his life on such a Mousou. Sion Ichinose, an ordinary student attending Crawford Magic Academy. Sion continued to behave like an "SSS-Rank" both inside and outside the school, but his eccentric behavior eventually involved those around him...? Only his Mousou and acting are SSS-Rank! The "strongest" mistaken Hero tale of a single, crazy C-Rank magic student grandly opens here!!

2137c013-52ca-4415-a7d9-7e9dbdec2bfb.title: Aoki Balkanalia
2137c013-52ca-4415-a7d9-7e9dbdec2bfb.description:
In a Bulgarian village under Ottoman rule during the 16th century, a young girl named Luca endures a life of mistreatment at the hands of her adoptive family, finding her only refuge under the protection of her adoptive brother, Lev. However, one day, soldiers from the Imperial army arrive on a hunt for young boys—and Lev is taken away. Thus begins the fateful tale of two souls, bound by a solemn vow to reunite!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

d05aa079-d86b-4f73-bc3d-9b7ed75a7ec3.description:
The story follows the crazy misadventures of Kaizo Katsu, a former child prodigy turned weirdo after his female childhood friend, Umi, kicked him off a jungle gym in the playground, and he got a huge bump in the head.  
  
With this set up, Kaizo (believes he is a cyborg) and his classmates, Umi (will go revealing her dark side with every chapter), Suzu, and Chitan (an inferior being?), will treat in every chapter a different topic of life with the hilarious and interesting way of thinking of the author Kumeta. The attacks of different geniuses/weirdos will create a lot of funny situations.
